scenarios.name: hop_timing_and_held_repeat
scenarios.description: a held direction hops on the first tick and again on the tick after each landing (every 7 ticks); directions are ignored mid-hop; Up beats Down

scenarios.name: blocked_edges_and_fall_through
scenarios.description: a direction blocked by the grid edge falls through to the next test, so fire is read with Up held on the top row; END on the bottom-right pad after one letter; the view is requested when the 32-tick pop ends

scenarios.name: three_letters_with_flips
scenarios.description: three letters including the dot, each flipping the next initials pad over 8 ticks with the model swapped at 0x500; a fourth letter is silently ignored; END with three letters

scenarios.name: back_at_zero_and_after_letters
scenarios.description: BACK with nothing entered does nothing; a space is a letter showing the blank pad; BACK rubs it out and flips the pad back to blank; fire during that flip is ignored; END with no letters

scenarios.name: end_with_two_letters_and_fire_during_flip
scenarios.description: fire during a flip is ignored while hops are not; END with two letters leaves the third a space

scenarios.name: occupied_pad_refused
scenarios.description: a hop onto a pad another active frog holds (player 1 on P) is refused: the frog turns but stays and fire is not read that tick

scenarios.name: no_high_score
scenarios.description: no qualifying score: startup requests the main options page and the update never runs

scenarios.name: game_quit
scenarios.description: the game was quit from the pause menu: startup requests the main options page before testing scores
